answer: Seed the grading pool with canaries: a small fraction of answers are decoys carrying a pre-sealed known verdict, planted like blighted trees scattered through a healthy orchard. Any identity that rubber-stamps them to clear its quota, the tell of a farm grading blind, has its whole kin-cluster slashed from reputation zenith to zero. To dodge the trap every clone must genuinely read and judge each item, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand real evaluations, not one cached whisper copied across all of them. Collusion stops scaling cheaply.
